name: Libraries optional import
description: Lets theme library assets be marked optional so missing CSS/JS files are dropped instead of causing errors.
project_description:
Allows optional assets in library definitions.

 Post-Installation 
 Add the optional library to the library definition in your module's libraries.yml file as shown below

 

global:

 version: 1.x

 css:

 theme:

 dist/app.css: { }

 dist/app-optional.css: { optional: true }

 js:

 dist/app.js: { }

 dist/app-optional.js: { optional: true }

 dependencies:

 - core/jquery

 - core/drupal

 - core/drupalSettings

 - core/once
